description: Land Title Settlement Department - Petapola, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420903 (23/0401)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles as specified in Type 4 classification.
